task.title: Coding task description
task.description: Describe the coding problem or implementation goal for which context should be gathered.
task.prefill: Build a Python FastAPI endpoint for file upload to S3

max_sources.title: Maximum sources
max_sources.description: Maximum number of sources to discover and process.

allowed_domains.title: Allowed domains
allowed_domains.description: Optional allowlist of domains to restrict search and crawling.

include_github.title: Include GitHub
include_github.description: Include GitHub repository mining in the context pipeline.

include_github_code_search.title: Include GitHub code search
include_github_code_search.description: Enable GitHub code search to retrieve implementation snippets.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Optional GitHub token for authenticated GitHub API requests and richer code search. If omitted, actor falls back to unauthenticated mining.

github_code_languages.title: Languages for GitHub code search
github_code_languages.description: Target languages for GitHub code search (e.g., ['python', 'typescript']). If empty, uses detected language from task.

include_stackoverflow.title: Include StackOverflow Q&A
include_stackoverflow.description: Mine high-quality answers from StackOverflow for developer context

enable_cache.title: Enable caching
enable_cache.description: Cache scraped pages and task results for faster repeated runs

chunk_size.title: LLM chunk token size
chunk_size.description: Maximum tokens per chunk for LLM-optimized content splitting

max_code_snippets.title: Maximum code snippets
max_code_snippets.description: Maximum number of code snippets to include in the output.

enable_llm_synthesis.title: Enable LLM RAG synthesis
enable_llm_synthesis.description: Enable LLM-powered synthesis of gathered context into actionable coding guidance using OpenRouter.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: API key for OpenRouter LLM synthesis. Can also be set via OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

openrouter_model.title: OpenRouter model
openrouter_model.description: Model ID to use for LLM synthesis via OpenRouter.
